title: Now sort your own photos
drDigitalIntro:
You have edited, shared, favourited and recovered photos in the practice library. Now open yours.
• Find a photo you like and mark it as a favourite.
• Make an album and put three or four related photos in it — a trip, a person, an occasion.
• Try the editing tools on one photo: brightness, crop, a filter. There is always a way to undo.
• Delete a photo you do not want, then look in Recently Deleted to see that it is still recoverable.
drDigitalSuccess: Your own library works the same way, and nothing you did is permanent for at least thirty days.
drDigitalHint: Read along, then open the photo app on your own computer or phone.
